notes.title: Luna’s Diary: Meet the Mounts
notes.notes:
Hello again, it’s Luna! Me and Niko have been so busy on our [url=https://about.my.games/news/276]journey through The Magical World[/url] that we forgot to properly introduce our friends! 

Across the many realms you’ll explore, you’ll meet [b]Mounts [/b]to assist you—they’re not only useful rides, but valuable allies in battle.
[h2]Dino the Dinosaur[/h2]
Dino the Dinosaur is as strong as he is scaly, and this mean, green, chomping machine was a huge advantage against Cobrings! Dino eats enemies and spits them back out, which is super useful to defeat other foes or break through obstacles. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45052290/71148ed895048a0917998809a22c5b28645db225.png[/img]
[h2]Todd the Toad[/h2]
Todd the Toad is our favorite ally amphibian, able to jump incredibly high with his lofty leaps, allowing me and Niko to reach new heights of exploration. This versatile verdant companion also spits venom at enemies, so we could breeze through foes with ease from a distance. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45052290/2a709c9659bb411a6fbf1a06c291f8a51b9b8bfc.png[/img]
[h2]Boaris the Boar[/h2]
Boaris the Boar is a sturdy swine capable of charging enemies and smashing through obstacles like a knife through butter. Boaris’ forward charge busts through barriers and knocks back enemies in his path. Our porcine pal was definitely a durable companion when we were faced with big groups of Cobrings!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45052290/66b521b56671ad771fc92378b8bb3d227c63e261.png[/img]
[h2]Oceanis the Seahorse[/h2]
While mongooses can’t breathe underwater, Oceanis sure can! Not only that, our Pacific pal is a speed swimmer, who helped us out a lot in aquatic environments. Oceanis is not only a great mount for maneuvering through murky depths, but also has a ranged laser beam attack to defeat underwater foes and clear obstacles!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45052290/c0d537f6eb1ae3ad2f85e42bac07f573a57e6079.png[/img]
[h2]Umbra the Bat[/h2]
We’d have gone truly batty without Umbra to help us out in certain aerial situations! Umbra the Bat gave us the power of flight, allowing us to discover secret areas, reach elevated platforms, and avoid flying foes. Umbra’s sonic screech attack also damages enemies and breaks barriers.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45052290/6c7c852d0114837c50864ef2131905ba46c7bc18.png[/img]

Now you know all about your new mounts, get out there and start chomping, flying, swimming, and charging! Luna, signin’ off!

notes.title: Luna’s Diary: Seek Out the Secret World
notes.notes:
Hey, adventurers—Luna, here! Are you ready to check out the beautiful, fun, and downright dangerous realms that await you? As Niko and I journey through The Magical World, I’ve been making notes on each zone we visit to help out our fellow travelers. 

There’s plenty of loot to pick up and scenery to enjoy, so don’t forget to collect everything and see it all! 

Just when we thought our adventure was over, we discovered another realm to explore! 
[h2]Secret World[/h2]
Niko and I couldn’t wait to discover this new world, and leapt into action immediately, landing in the eerie castle at [b]Acid Elevators[/b]. As the elevator descended, we picked up as much loot as our paws could carry, being careful to avoid the Cobrings trying to stop our fun! 

Next up was [b]Spider Mines[/b], a dark cavern teeming with creepy crawlies, cruel Cobrings, and minecart madness! We travelled along the abandoned mining rails, jumping gaps and avoiding falling boulders on a rollercoaster ride, until we crashed into the chilly atmosphere of [b]Frost Flight.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45052290/d1cd2ab577160b6df94e7bc89b19968eedcb5848.png[/img]

Delving deeper into this snow-laden scene, Niko deftly dove to avoid dangerous spikes, projectiles, and falling pillars. Little did we know, the worst was yet to come!

We arrived at [b]Crushing Grounds[/b], a stone fortress with several foes to beat and even more obstacles to overcome. Timing is key here, or you may find yourself flattened! 

[b]Rainshot Citadel[/b] was up next, an overgrown, wooded area of the castle with perilous airbourne obstacles to use to your advantage. The bad weather may be atmospheric, but this heavy rain was certainly not relaxing! 

Soon it was time for [b]The Final Battle[/b]. An old foe had returned, and we’d have to use all our cunning and skills to defeat them once and for all…

Niko and I hope you enjoy each world you encounter on your adventures as much as we did! Luna, signin’ off!

notes.title: Nikoderiko: The Magical World – Director’s Cut (PC) Review
notes.notes:
Nikoderiko: The Magical World – Director’s Cut, as its title suggests, puts players back in the shoes of the titular Niko and Luna in an expanded and upgraded version of its 2024 original release.

At first glance, Nikoderiko: The Magical World – Director’s Cut may not appear to be a significant upgrade over its initial release, but a closer look reveals a wealth of new content. One of the more apparent changes is a noticeable improvement in visual fidelity, particularly in lighting and material quality. Environments such as gemstones and lava tend to stand out more than in the original version, contrasting with the foliage and rougher materials in a way that surpasses the visual quality of the 2024 game.

On the topic of visual fidelity and graphics, it will be interesting to see how the director’s cut of Nikoderiko fares on lower-end platforms like the Nintendo Switch, as the original release on that platform already suffered from noticeable performance issues. Hopefully,... Read more

notes.title: Luna’s Diary: Crash Cobring Base!
notes.notes:
Hey, adventurers—Luna, here! Are you ready to check out the beautiful, fun, and downright dangerous realms that await you? As Niko and I journey through The Magical World, I’ve been making notes on each zone we visit to help out our fellow travelers. 

There’s plenty of loot to pick up, and scenery to enjoy, so don’t forget to collect everything and see it all! 

It’s time for one final adventure in [b]Cobring Base.[/b]
[h2]Cobring Base [/h2]

It was time for our final stop on our journey. We’d finally found that dastardly Baron Grimbald’s hideaway! [b]Airtube Adventures[/b] was the first location we hit, a complex copper factory full of floating flumes (a perfect excuse for Niko to use his glider). 

After finishing off some bouncing Cobrings, we headed to [b]Conveyor Spark Sprint[/b]. Niko and I ran as fast as our little paws could carry us to avoid being electrified! I dread to think what that would have done to our fur…

[b][img]https://static-eu.prod-my.games/chronos-public-eu-mg-prod/site/Nikoderiko/355/World_7_1_Base_2.png[/img][/b]

After narrowly escaping that circuit of danger, we arrived at [b]Flicker Factory[/b], an eerie abandoned plant where we avoided even more dangerous mechanisms—this time, in the dark! With only blinking light bulbs to guide our way, it was hard to figure out our next steps, but we made it through using our keen adventuring senses, and arrived at [b]Mount Mayhem[/b].

Suddenly the industrial architecture became overrun with nature, and lush greenery covered the machines and iron walkways. One thing hadn’t changed though—the amount of enemies to defeat! As we smashed our way through Cobrings, we had a feeling that the ultimate treasure was nearby. 

We were right, and we soon arrived at [b]Grimbald’s Treasury[/b]! Finally, we were face to face with [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2374190/view/514079741259549039]Baron Grimbald[/url]… and the rest is history! 

Niko and I hope you enjoy each world you encounter on your adventures as much as we did! Luna, signin’ off!

notes.title: Luna’s Boss Diary: Baron Grimbald
notes.notes:
Hey adventurers, Luna here! As you journey through The Magical World with Niko and me, you’ll come across dangerous and devious Bosses! I’ve been making notes on every dastardly foe we see to help out our fellow adventurers.

It’s time to face our final foe: [b]Baron Grimbald![/b]

[b][img]https://static-eu.prod-my.games/chronos-public-eu-mg-prod/site/Nikoderiko/321/Cobring-Base.png[/img][/b]
[h2]Baron Grimbald[/h2]

Our adventure was coming to a close, and as bittersweet as it was, the temptation to give in to our treasure-hunting nature was too strong. As we entered Cobring Base, we ignored the dangers and pressed ahead. In the final room of the factory, we narrowly avoided a sticky end at the hands of dangerous mechanisms that can burn, crush, electrocute or drown you! And then we laid eyes on the motherload—a treasure chest!

We ventured forth to claim our riches, but the door to the room suddenly closed! The floor opened up to reveal toxic green sludge, separating us from the chest. That wasn’t all, as the scimitar-wielding Baron Grimbald revealed himself. The battle was on!

[b][img]https://static-eu.prod-my.games/chronos-public-eu-mg-prod/site/Nikoderiko/321/Treasure-Chest.jpg[/img][/b]

Baron Grimbald is as greedy as he is gruesome, and the fight was a battle for the books.

The brazen Baron began by swinging his saber at us and leaping across the room, while we attempted to evade his attacks and launch our own attacks back. Once we’d hit Grimbald enough, he retreated back to the top of the treasure chest, and Niko and I began to climb upwards to reach him, dodging traps and falling debris! 

At the top, we took on the Baron’s minions wave by wave until, with one final powerful blow from Niko, the Baron was defeated. 

Niko and I wish you luck in your battles with each fearsome foe you meet. Luna, signin’ off!

notes.title: New “Realism” Mode Coming to Nikoderiko June 31!
notes.notes:
We hope you’ve been enjoying your time in the Magical World, as it’s about to get real! You’ll be able to play your favorite platformer as a realistic mongoose in the [b]new Realism Mode, coming June 31, 2025![/b]

As well as new animations and character models, you’ll also be able to get to grips with new features that truly capture the essence of being a pair of adventuring mongooses!

[img]https://static-eu.prod-my.games/chronos-public-eu-mg-prod/site/Nikoderiko/351/2.png[/img]
[h2]New Feature: Snake Snack[/h2]

Take on Cobrings in a whole new way with the [b]“Snake Snack” feature! [/b]Those little snakes don’t stand a chance against the newly authentic Luna and Niko—[b]gobble them down [/b]without a second thought and [b]receive an extra Life![/b] 

[h2]New Feature: Venom-Resistant[/h2]

Don’t worry about your foes fighting back, as real mongooses are [b]resistant to venom,[/b] and now you are too, [b]taking little to no damage from enemies[/b] in this new way to play. 

[img]https://static-eu.prod-my.games/chronos-public-eu-mg-prod/site/Nikoderiko/351/3%20(1).png[/img]
[h2]New Cutscenes: Incommunicado [/h2]

Real mongooses can’t talk, and now Luna and Niko can’t speak either! Get to grips with the true way of [b]communicating [/b]like a mongoose—[b]leaving scent markers. [/b]Now each cutscene will feature Niko and Luna smearing their surroundings with viscous trails—convenient for finding your way around! 

We hope you enjoy the [b]new Realism Mode[/b] when it drops on June 31—you’d be a [i]fool [/i]not to!

notes.title: Luna’s Boss Diary: Toby The Dragon
notes.notes:
Hey adventurers, Luna here! As you journey through The Magical World with Niko and me, you’ll come across dangerous and devious Bosses! I’ve been making notes on every dastardly foe we see to help out our fellow adventurers.

Next up: [b]Toby the Dragon![/b]

[img]https://static-eu.prod-my.games/chronos-public-eu-mg-prod/site/Nikoderiko/318/World_6_2_Desert_1%20(1).png[/img]
[h2]Toby The Dragon[/h2]

Dry Sea by name, but not quite by nature! As we explored the definitely wet parts of this realm, Niko and I stumbled upon a mysterious old ship—just in time for our stomachs to start rumbling! 

Seeing this as a perfect opportunity to express his humility, Niko declared that he’d catch us a fish for dinner with his “talents”. I joked that I hoped it’d be as big as his ego! I should have been more careful what I wished for—as instead of catching a delicious fish, Niko reeled in [b]Toby! [/b]

[img]https://static-eu.prod-my.games/chronos-public-eu-mg-prod/site/Nikoderiko/318/World_6_Boss_2.png[/img]
Toby the Dragon certainly gave us a shock when he appeared from the murky depths, but thankfully we had the ship wreckage to hide behind when avoiding his fire-breathing attacks. We also had a cannon at our disposal, which Niko used to carefully time our shots at Toby. 

Toby’s attacks didn’t stop there, as the dastardly dragon fired fireballs and showers of meteors, as well as sending shockwaves across the ship that we had to dodge! 

We finally managed to put Toby back in the drink where he belonged, and as he fell back into the watery abyss, the mighty splash that drenched us also provided Niko with the fish he promised to catch! Some mongooses have all the luck…

Niko and I wish you luck in your battles with each fearsome foe you meet. Luna, signin’ off!

notes.title: Luna’s Diary: Marvel at Magic Wood!
notes.notes:
Hey, adventurers—Luna, here! Are you ready to check out the beautiful, fun, and downright dangerous realms that await you? As Niko and I journey through The Magical World, I’ve been making notes on each zone we visit to help out our fellow travelers. 

There’s plenty of loot to pick up, and scenery to enjoy, so don’t forget to collect everything and see it all! 

Next up: [b]Magic Wood[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45052290/582fb18bccedf23f24b2a4a379829002fd3fea9b.png[/img]
[h3]Magic Wood[/h3]

Magic by name, magic by nature. This fantastical forest is complete with giant mushrooms and is a wonder to behold and explore. First up was [b]Fallwood Treasure Terrors[/b], a mystical place home to Ents and plenty of fun foliage for Niko to climb! 

From scrumptious scenery to sour prickly foes—we soon tumbled into [b]Thorns Valley[/b]! This zone was full of icky insects, bouncy funghi, and plenty of spiky saboteurs to dispatch. 

Soon we arrived at the suspiciously-named [b]Under Pressure[/b]—but no world is a match for Niko’s parkour prowess, and we breezed through the floating pedestals, hopped on the heads of Cobrings, and avoided giant battering rams. He really cooked up a storm!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45052290/d740fd949684686e926ae6a8cffe1f7fc4db2404.png[/img]
[b]Glimmering Grove[/b] is just as incredible as the name suggests—a deliciously scenic land full of giant tree trunks and glowing rocks, all set against the backdrop of flowing waterfalls. However, it still had its fair share of enemies to fight! 

Just as we were getting a taste for magical forests, we landed in [b]Chef’s Cafe[/b]! A far cry from the wonders of the rest of Magic Wood, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2374190/view/576003055336556368]Chef[/url] had a more sinister goal in mind—to make mongoose stew! 

After escaping the greedy cook’s grasp, it’s safe to say that we lost our appetites for a while!

Niko and I hope you enjoy each world you encounter on your adventures as much as we did! Luna, signin’ off!

notes.title: Luna’s Boss Diary: Chef
notes.notes:
Hey adventurers, Luna here! As you journey through The Magical World with Niko and me, you’ll come across dangerous and devious Bosses! I’ve been making notes on every dastardly foe we see to help out our fellow adventurers.

Next up: [b]Chef[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45052290/890d4019364d578ab470cce866c2a12304882286.png[/img]
[h3]Chef[/h3]

Magic Woods has all the ingredients for a mystical adventure: giant mushrooms, sky-scraping towers, luminescent caves, and…a chef?! 

As we traversed through this astonishing realm, we met Tim the Cook, who invited us (rather too enthusiastically) to sample the culinary masterpieces of his boss—Chef. Niko never says no to a complimentary dinner, but as the saying goes: there’s no such thing as a free lunch! It turns out that the Chef didn’t want to serve us a meal, we were the meal! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45052290/3de7706b44aea2b44aa740a21d862382ef7de86a.png[/img]
The battle came to a boil in Chef’s very own kitchen, where Niko and I hurled dynamite at the greedy gourmand, taking care to avoid the deadly green slop being launched at us from his cauldron. Chef had one more tasty trick up his sleeve—line cook minions pushed us away from our cover, meaning we had to dodge the gross goo instead of hiding from it. 

After defeating the kooky cook in round one, he came back with a vengeance and began to spin around like a blender, trying to make a mongoose smoothie. With each spin, Chef bonked his head, leaving him stunned and open for us to make our move. Niko ground pounded him, and the food fight was won! 

Chef may have thought he had the recipe for success, but Niko and I know our way around the kitchen!

Niko and I wish you luck in your battles with each fearsome foe you meet. Luna, signin’ off!

notes.title: Luna’s Diary: Slide Into Snowland!
notes.notes:
Hey, adventurers—Luna, here! Are you ready to check out the beautiful, fun, and downright dangerous realms that await you? As Niko and I journey through The Magical World, I’ve been making notes on each zone we visit to help out our fellow travelers. 

There’s plenty of loot to pick up, and scenery to enjoy, so don’t forget to collect everything and see it all! 

Next up: [b]Snowland[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45052290/575850045485e7c8a1a8eee08bc399ae2d8d684f.png[/img]
[h3]Snowland[/h3]

As mongooses, Niko and I don’t feel the cold very much—which was just as well in Snowland! This frigid realm had beautiful sunsets and snowstorms, as well as caves flooded with icy water, geysers, and steep cliffs.

[b]Geyser Cliffs[/b] was up first, a wonderful winter landscape with snow-topped trees, sheer drops, and plenty of brr-azen baddies to defeat! 

Next, we were swept up in the tides of [b]Cold Waves[/b], an underwater oasis full of sea life (some friendly, some not so much!). After we narrowly escaped being crushed by rocks and munched by mini sea monsters, we arrived at [b]Riptor’s Rage[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45052290/db5e1e1f42431e6beefcc425d5b07d0509814ca8.png[/img]

The second we landed, we were under siege! Avoiding the cannons from Riptor was no easy feat, but we managed to escape relatively unscathed (with some armfuls of treasure, too!).

Barrelling into [b]Junkyard Madness[/b], Niko deftly leapfrogged over projectile tires, taking out foes on the way.
Soon we were lured into [b]Robokong’s Cave[/b] with the promise of loot, but got more than we bargained for when it came to fighting [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/2374190/announcements/detail/514077209152981868]Robokong[/url] itself! 

Niko and I hope you enjoy each world you encounter on your adventures as much as we did! Luna, signin’ off!

notes.title: Luna’s Boss Diary: Robokong
notes.notes:
Hey adventurers, Luna here! As you journey through The Magical World with Niko and me, you’ll come across dangerous and devious Bosses! I’ve been making notes on every dastardly foe we see to help out our fellow adventurers.

Time to put the pedal to the metal! Next up: [b]Robokong![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45052290/6d1efd91f8f34d95d51a2ee166524a098cab37fb.png[/img]
[h3]Robokong[/h3]

Snowland may be cold, but its landscapes are beautiful enough to warm even the iciest heart! As we traversed the land and sea across this realm, we overcame flooded caves, geysers, and steep cliffs, but nothing as perilous as what would come next. 

While taking a breather from our hike in a cave, we met one of the Baron’s henchmen—Screwy—who told us three devious monkeys stole his robot while he was napping, and that we should be on the lookout for any stray metal machines. We wouldn’t have to wait long. Niko spotted a banana, and as he munched on his snack, the monkeys appeared to avenge their fallen food!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45052290/dee69f640c87488785001ba5d6b0f04cda526f41.png[/img]

You’ve heard of three monkeys in a trenchcoat, but trust me—three monkeys in a robot is much scarier and way less funny! Niko and I began hurling explosive barrels and dynamite at Robokong, dodging its punches and jumping over its spinning arm attacks.

Just when we thought we were out of the woods, Robokong appeared above us, and shaky platforms emerged underneath me and Niko from the lava below–talk about a molten point of contention! Robokong unleashed powerful hammer strikes that smashed more and more sections of the ground beneath us.

Robokong was tough, but we made it out with only a little bit of singed fur. He meant (monkey) business! 

Niko and I wish you luck in your battles with each fearsome foe you meet. Luna, signin’ off!

notes.title: Luna’s Diary: Swing Into Sky Vines!
notes.notes:
Hey, adventurers—Luna, here! Are you ready to check out the beautiful, fun, and downright dangerous realms that await you? As Niko and I journey through The Magical World, I’ve been making notes on each zone we visit to help out our fellow travelers. 

There’s plenty of loot to pick up, and scenery to enjoy, so don’t forget to collect everything and see it all! 
Next stop: [b]Sky Vines.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45052290/928d3cda2f04eb7fff12e524376042e1780da1f1.png[/img]
[h3]Sky Vines[/h3]

My favorite thing about our adventures is the beautiful places we get to experience, and Sky Vines did not disappoint. Niko seems more concerned with getting stuck right into the action. Luckily for him, there was no lack of that here!

[b]Crazy Cannons[/b] was up first, which featured (you guessed it)—tons of cannons! Niko blasted his way through like a true daredevil until we made it to [b]Dino Vines[/b].

It was here we met up with our scaly ally (or scally!) [b]Dino[/b], who helped us out by letting us hitch a ride on his back while gobbling up our foes and spitting them out, and smashing through obstacles with ease. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45052290/d1825cf2fa2eec4f39e92d985110ecb9b701bc20.png[/img]
[b]Swinging Shrine Falls[/b] was the next stop on our adventure. While I marveled at the stunning architecture, Niko was leaping across moving platforms, avoiding spikes, and taking out countless foes both above ground and in the waters below. 

Soon we arrived at [b]Frogs and Frights[/b], where our friend [b]Todd the Toad[/b] picked us up and helped us to take down enemies with his super spitting power! 

Finally, we reached [b]Sally's Swamp[/b], a toxic swamp where [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2374190/view/514077209152981628]Sally The Flower[/url] was waiting…

Niko and I hope you enjoy each world you encounter on your adventures as much as we did! Luna, signin’ off!

notes.title: Luna’s Boss Diary: Sally The Flower
notes.notes:
Hey adventurers, Luna here! As you [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2374190/view/514076038036193392]journey through The Magical World[/url] with Niko and me, you’ll come across dangerous and devious Bosses! I’ve been making notes on every dastardly foe we see to help out our fellow adventurers.

Next up: [b]Sally The Flower![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45052290/7fac99c8a9ecec59f26a33dab5a1f6dc7c6d7814.png[/img]
[h3]Sally The Flower[/h3]

Sky Vines is one of the most picturesque realms we’ve encountered. Unfortunately for us, many enemies thought so too, and made it their home. As Niko confidently swung through the vines (not being too careful around the brambles…) we came across a small petalled friend who jumped into a pool of bubbling, green water—and transformed into a giant floral beast!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45052290/d06064f7a7a54489edcbff974b0aa0547a8cfb31.png[/img]

This toxic ooze was Sally’s Swamp, and Sally The Flower rose from the goo. A truly terrifying sight! Thankfully, we had our prehistoric pal [b]Dino[/b] on our side to help fight off the fiendish flower’s projectiles and whipping vines.

Sally wasn’t alone in this fight. She had Krumms on her side, which Dino had to eat to stop them from self-destructing and exploding! Eventually, we tamed the tropical tyrant and managed to stop and smell the flowers along the way. 

If you thought a flower couldn’t be scary—think again! Sally was no pansy.

Niko and I wish you luck in your battles with each fearsome foe you meet. Luna, signin’ off!

notes.title: Luna’s Diary: Step Into Skyward Falls!
notes.notes:
Hey, adventurers—Luna, here! Are you ready to check out the beautiful, fun, and downright dangerous realms that await you? As Niko and I journey through The Magical World, I’ve been making notes on each zone we visit to help out our fellow travelers. 

There’s plenty of loot to pick up, and scenery to enjoy, so don’t forget to collect everything and see it all! First stop: [b]Skyward Falls.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45052290/3b231325763ef4b374df634287eca16a337f65ea.png[/img]
[h3]Skyward Falls[/h3]

Niko and I might possess different skills and prerogatives (I want knowledge and Niko wants adventure), but our shared motive has, and always will be—[b]finding treasure[/b]! 

Skyward Falls is a fantastic world to start our adventure off with. This tropical island is beautiful and has a dense jungle, ancient temples, secret coves, and cavernous caves. Niko didn’t seem to appreciate the natural beauty surrounding us. Typical!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45052290/2be1eb17cb404b90b2a5e191942a2e17115fb994.jpg[/img]
When we landed on the island, our first job was to get our bearings after climbing down from the airship. Unfortunately, the first sight we saw was terrifying—remnants of past adventurers who met a spiky end! After leaving that not-so-pretty warning, we made our way through lethal puzzles, avoiding traps and pitfalls, until we reached the prize we’d been searching for—[b]a shiny treasure chest![/b]

No sooner had we lugged the thing out of its cave home did we run into Baron Grimbald and his Cobring army, who had destroyed our airship and proceeded to nab the chest! After a hasty (and almost explosive) getaway, our true adventure began. Time to [b]reclaim the relic![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45052290/2851e2d558e2caacfd29bc352d6fd22354dbaf78.png[/img]
[b]Sacred Forest[/b] was first up, a leafy jungle adorned with beautiful bioluminescent plants to guide our way, and complete with serene waterfalls. It wasn’t all peaceful, though. Some Cobrings tried to get in our way, but a quick Ground Pound saw to them. 

Soon came the [b]Tricky Caves[/b]. Tricky by name, tricky by nature! There were plenty of hazards down here, but the awesome Aztec-inspired architecture made up for all that (to me anyway, Niko wasn’t so convinced). 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45052290/507650ad5a39b7ca45a2e9f51d61a4a7ecf1bb23.jpg[/img]
Then we hit the [b]Owlspire Wheels[/b], a winding path of rotating wheels designed to slow us down on our quest! 

After clearing that cylindrical chaos, we dove into [b]Jellyfish Cove[/b]. Whoever said it was better down where it’s wetter was sorely mistaken. Those stings hurt!

Finally, we came upon a dam, and had to face off against[b] Darby The Beaver.[/b] Well, [url=https://about.my.games/news/290]we all know how that ended![/url]

Our first world was a whirlwind, but I’ve managed to piece together this diary from shredded and damp notes. Hope it helps! 

Niko and I hope you enjoy each world you encounter on your adventures as much as we did! Luna, signin’ off!

notes.title: Luna’s Boss Diary: Crusher
notes.notes:
Hey adventurers, Luna here! As you [url=https://about.my.games/news/276]journey through The Magical World[/url] with Niko and me, you’ll come across dangerous and devious Bosses! I’ve been making notes on every dastardly foe we see to help out our fellow adventurers.

Next up: [b]Crusher![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45052290/8fe2382fd5e3974f4865c5dcc8f1b2ae213cfedf.png[/img]
[h3]Crusher[/h3]

We couldn’t have imagined what awaited us in Cobring Mines—an evil mineowner named Crusher. He was unlike any dragon we’d ever encountered. He even had drills for arms! This scaly scoundrel assumed we’d entered his domain to offer up our services working in his mine–but when Niko unknowingly insulted him (typical!) the battle was on. 

Crusher took chase, and we had to run as fast as our little mongoose legs could to escape his attacks, dodging and ducking as we leaped over minecarts, pits, and barriers. 

We ended up inside one of the rusty carts, where the real fight began. Still racing along the tracks, Crusher pursued us while he shot at stalactites, which hit the tracks, making hazardous pits! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45052290/b257e7bc601d5df516d090544e24d89dab5f14ec.png[/img]

Eventually, Crusher caught up to us and we all fell into a musty mine, where the dastardly dragon rolled into us, firing fire and drill shots we had to nimbly dodge, as well as trying to hit us with carts! 

It was one tough fight, and it took us a long time to completely defeat him, especially when he got angry—you wouldn’t like him when he’s angry… 

Beware if you enter Cobring Mines, as this grizzly guy is a force to be reckoned with. 

Niko and I wish you luck in your battles with each fearsome foe you meet. Luna, signin’ off!

notes.title: Luna’s Boss Diary: Darby The Beaver
notes.notes:
Hey, adventurers—Luna here! As you journey through The Magical World with Niko and me, you’ll come across dangerous and devious Bosses! I’ve been making notes on every dastardly foe we see to help out our fellow adventurers.

First up: [b]Darby the Beaver![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45052290/99b1f6261a9dbe8fe46dfca7885f4a27a6b6cc50.png[/img]

[h2]Darby The Beaver[/h2]

Darby is certainly one angry beaver! Niko and I ventured into Skyward Falls without knowing what awaited us. Unfortunately, Niko’s headstrong attitude got us into trouble almost immediately—Darby thought we destroyed the dam he’s been obsessively building near his river home! 

Luckily, we had [b]Todd the Toad[/b] on our side to hop us safely out of his reach while we fought off his attempts to avenge his fallen dam. We jumped higher and higher as Darby sent humongous waves to pull us underwater to our doom, destroying our projectiles. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45052290/7a4d3619f7d5b30d47000b4b28ec20a7f3f422e1.png[/img]

Darby became enraged, and his attacks grew so strong that we weren’t sure we’d make it to adventure another day! However, we bested the furry beast and lived to tell this tale. 

Niko and I wish you luck in your battles with each fearsome foe you meet. Luna, signin’ off!

notes.title: Nikoderiko: The Magical World | New Update (January 10, 2025)
notes.notes:
A new update for Nikoderiko: The Magical World is now available! This update introduces gameplay improvements, visual enhancements, and bug fixes. Let’s dive into the details to explore what’s improved, and what’s been fixed!

[h3]Gameplay Changes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the second co-op player could remain stuck in a bubble after mount interactions in 3D.
[*] Resolved issues preventing dodging the wave attack during the Toby the Dragon fight if the level was restarted.
[*] Fixed Niko’s sliding behavior after jumping on jump pads.
[*] Fixed the ability to exit the playable area in [b]Under Pressure[/b] and [b]Flicker Factory[/b] by dismounting.
[*] Fixed character movement issues when mounting and during mount summons.
[*] Fixed several issues related to respawning, especially the second co-op player respawning without a Jetpack ([b]Dragon Chase[/b]) or in unexpected states.
[*] Fixed co-op activation in a bonus level, causing the second player to not appear upon respawn.
[*] Fixed issue where Niko would slide on the floor for a few seconds after loading into the boss fight with Baron Grimbald.
[*] Fixed movement issues that occurred when Niko spawned into phase two of the boss fight with Chef.
[*] Fixed enemy animation inconsistencies.
[*] Fixed issue where Luna's model would hover above Todd the Toad after restarting the boss fight with Darby the Beaver.
[/list]
[h3]Visual Improvements:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed incorrect status display for levels on the global map.
[*] Fixed incorrect shading causing overly dark grass near the first bonus in the [b]Sacred Forest[/b] level.
[*] Fixed low-quality character shadows.
[*] Fixed excessive brightness on key items in the [b]Airtube Adventures[/b] loading screen.
[*] Fixed graphical glitch where the Toby the Dragon’s textures and player model overlapped in the co-op version of [b]Dragon Chase[/b].
[*] Fixed the floating mushroom appearing in the first bonus of level [b]Thorns Valley[/b].
[*] Fixed decorative falling rocks stopping mid-air in [b]Under Pressure[/b].
[*] Fixed animation issues, causing the boss fight with Darby the Beaver to start during its cutscene.
[*] Fixed model distortions of enemy Cobring in [b]Owlspire Wheels[/b].
[*] Fixed floating crab disappearance near the letter K in [b]Sacred Forest[/b].
[*] Fixed incorrect animation of glowing fish after a co-op player's death.
[*] Fixed inconsistencies in visual effects when shooting out of a cannon after exiting a bonus level.
[*] Fixed character model clipping through platforms when jumping onto them in [b]Geyser Cliffs[/b].
[/list]
[h3]Audio Improvements:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed missing or out-of-sync sound effects related to various game actions, such as wheel mechanics, firefly disappearance, dragon animations, and barrel impacts.
[/list]
[h3]User Interface (UI) Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed UI issues where collected letters were not marked correctly after death, and several other UI bugs related to the shop, pause button, and map screen behavior.
[/list]
[h3]Camera Improvements:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed abrupt camera movement in co-op 3D segments when a player entered a bubble off-screen.
[*] Fixed vertical camera snapping when the second co-op player died off-screen.
[*] Fixed camera losing focus on characters when exiting 3D free roam areas in [b]Tricky Caves[/b].
[*] Fixed camera jitter in 3D free roam areas in [b]Swinging Shrine Falls[/b].
[*] Fixed incorrect camera positioning when transitioning between 3D and 2D segments in levels like [b]Crazy Cannons[/b] and [b]Owlspire Wheels[/b].
[*] Fixed camera movement inconsistencies when the second player is revived in the co-op version of [b]Swinging Shrine Falls[/b].
[*] Fixed camera positioning issues when jumping across logs using Todd the Toad in the [b]Sacred Forest [/b]level.
[/list]
[h3]Level and Environmental Improvements:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed issue where geysers in [b]Geyser Cliffs[/b] triggered incorrect dust animations when jumping.
[*] Fixed co-op logic breaking in [b]Junkyard Madness[/b] after exiting the first bonus.
[*] Fixed movement inconsistencies preventing the second co-op player from being pulled into a jump pad in [b]Dino Vines[/b].
[*] Fixed incorrect terrain behavior where players could fall through platforms in [b]Geyser Cliffs[/b].
[*] Fixed the disappearance of Oceanis the Seahorse after exiting the water in the co-op version of the [b]Shadow Fish Lagoon[/b] level.
[*] Fixed inconsistencies in terrain interactions, including unintended character teleportation and unresponsive collision in certain areas.
[/list]
[h3]Bug Fixes and Optimizations:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed various co-op related input-blocking issues when summoning mounts or transitioning into levels.
[*] Fixed co-op player respawn inconsistencies, causing players to remain invisible in certain scenarios.
[*] Fixed an issue where characters could incorrectly respawn outside playable areas.
[*] Fixed an issue where players could bypass key level mechanics using unintended movement exploits.
[*] Fixed visual inconsistencies between in-game rendering and level editor distances.
[*] Fixed incorrect behavior causing characters to remain visible after certain death and respawn sequences.
[*] Fixed issue where a co-op player would not despawn after exiting a bonus level.
[/list]

notes.title: Happy Holidays from Nikoderiko!
notes.notes:
From the whole Nikoderiko: The Magical World team, we wish you happy holidays! Thank you for your continued support over the last few months, and for loving the game! Luna and Niko are so pleased you’re all enjoying your adventures with them.

notes.title: Luna’s Boss Diary: Robokong
notes.notes:
Hey adventurers, Luna here! As you journey through The Magical World with Niko and me, you’ll come across dangerous and devious Bosses! I’ve been making notes on every dastardly foe we see to help out our fellow adventurers.

Time to put the pedal to the metal! Next up: [b]Robokong![/b]

[img]https://static-eu.prod-my.games/chronos-public-eu-mg-prod/site/Nikoderiko/307/World_4_1_Snowland_Geyser_2.png[/img]
[h2]Robokong[/h2]
Snowland may be cold, but its landscapes are beautiful enough to warm even the iciest heart! As we traversed the land and sea across this realm, we overcame flooded caves, geysers, and steep cliffs, but nothing as perilous as what would come next. 

While taking a breather from our hike in a cave, we met one of the Baron’s henchmen—Screwy—who told us three devious monkeys stole his robot while he was napping, and that we should be on the lookout for any stray metal machines. We wouldn’t have to wait long. Niko spotted a banana, and as he munched on his snack, the monkeys appeared to avenge their fallen food!

[img]https://static-eu.prod-my.games/chronos-public-eu-mg-prod/site/Nikoderiko/307/World_4_5_Boss_2.png[/img]

You’ve heard of three monkeys in a trenchcoat, but trust me—three monkeys in a robot is much scarier and way less funny! Niko and I began hurling explosive barrels and dynamite at Robokong, dodging its punches and jumping over its spinning arm attacks.

Just when we thought we were out of the woods, Robokong appeared above us, and shaky platforms emerged underneath me and Niko from the lava below–talk about a molten point of contention! Robokong unleashed powerful hammer strikes that smashed more and more sections of the ground beneath us.

Robokong was tough, but we made it out with only a little bit of singed fur. He meant (monkey) business! 

Niko and I wish you luck in your battles with each fearsome foe you meet. Luna, signin’ off!
